verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Realtime documents official SDKs for web and mobile through RealtimeKit. These include a prebuilt UI and a Core SDK for building fully custom interfaces. The SFU side is exposed as standard HTTPS APIs, and an OpenAPI spec is published. missing for 10: details on SDK languages and platform coverage, evidence of official SDKs for the raw SFU/TURN layers, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use prebuilt meeting UI and SDKs for web and mobile.
Use [RealtimeKit Core SDK](/realtime/realtimekit/humans/core/) to build every screen and interaction yourself.
Use standard HTTPS APIs and WebRTC from browsers, embedded firmware, native applications, and servers.
